📺 The Resident (2018–2023)

The Resident follows Conrad Hawkins, a talented and unconventional doctor working at Chastain Park Memorial Hospital in Atlanta, Georgia. Known for his rebellious personality and unwavering dedication to his patients, Conrad challenges hospital policies and exposes corruption within the healthcare system. When an ambitious young doctor named Devon Pravesh joins the hospital, Conrad becomes his mentor, teaching him that practicing medicine involves far more than following rules and medical textbooks. Alongside compassionate nurse practitioner Nic Nevin, skilled surgeon Mina Okafor, and other dedicated medical professionals, Conrad confronts life-threatening emergencies, complicated diagnoses, ethical dilemmas, and hospital politics. Beyond their demanding careers, the doctors navigate personal tragedies, romantic relationships, friendships, and emotional struggles. Starring Matt Czuchry, Emily VanCamp, Manish Dayal, and Bruce Greenwood, the series delivers gripping medical drama, powerful performances, and emotional storytelling while exploring compassion, medical ethics, corporate greed, sacrifice, and the importance of putting patients before profits.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Thriller • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 7.8/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 43 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Amy Holden Jones, Hayley Schore & Roshan Sethi

📺 Seasons: 6 • 107 Episodes

📍 Setting: Chastain Park Memorial Hospital in Atlanta, Georgia.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Netflix, Hulu, and Amazon Prime Video for current availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: The Resident is an American medical drama television series that aired on Fox from January 21, 2018, to January 17, 2023. The series premiered on Fox as a mid-season replacement during the 2017–18 television season. The series focuses on the lives and duties of staff members at fictional Chastain Park Memorial Hospital in Atlanta, Georgia, with generally a critical eye into current issues of medical practice and tensions in the healthcare industry. Created by Amy Holden Jones, Hayley Schore, and Roshan Sethi, the series was purchased by Fox from Showtime in 2017. In May 2017, Fox ordered the project to series, with a 14-episode season order.
